description: This file defines API endpoints using FastAPI for managing jobs related to branding compliance analysis. It includes routes for creating, deleting, uploading assets, analyzing, retrieving status/results/preview files, applying fixes, and downloading reports. It interacts with various services and models, manages workspace paths, and handles file uploads and downloads.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job, with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status and progress of a job.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request to fix a single asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request to run batch fixes across assets.

classes.name: PageEntry
classes.description: Represents a page preview entry with status, URLs, detection count, etc.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Creates a new job with optional metadata and initializes workspace JSON files.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Deletes a job and its workspace folder.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a ZIP of assets for a job, extracting contents into uploads/.

methods.name: upload_assets_multipart( job_id: str, request: Request, images: List[UploadFile] = File(default_factory=list, description="One or more input assets (images/docs)"), old_logo: UploadFile | None = File(default=None, description="Old brand/logo image"), new_logo: UploadFile | None = File(default=None, description="New brand/logo image"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Uploads assets and logos via multipart/form-data, saving files accordingly.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an old brand image for analysis.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a new brand image for overlay corrections.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis (logo detection, overlays, summarization) for a job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieves current job status and progress.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Lists assets and issues for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), page: int | None = Query(default=None, description="0-based page index (PDF only)"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Provides a preview image or overlay for an asset, with support for PDFs and pages.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs an automatic fix for a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs automatic fixes across all assets with detected issues.

methods.name: apply_fix(job_id: str, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Applies fixes across all detected pages and assets, may generate final PDFs.

methods.name: dict list_pages(job_id: str, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Lists per-page previews, detections, and statuses for a document.

methods.name: get_page_preview( job_id: str, index: int, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Returns a preview image for a specific page index, with fallback handling.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both", "pdf"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Downloads reports, zip archives, or PDFs for a job.
